pages.title: Support
pages.intro: The AI can blame you. Support won’t.

sections.title: Contact a human
paragraphs: For help, privacy requests, accessibility feedback, or an inappropriate ad, email Support.exeptionHuman@3qinnova.com. This inbox is operated by 3QInnova LLC. We do not promise a particular response time.

Tell us the app version, iPhone model, iOS version, level, and what happened. Screenshots are optional: crop out notifications, names, and other private information. Never send passwords, payment details, or an Apple account login.

sections.title: Report an ad
paragraphs: Pause the game, open Settings & help, and choose Report an ad. Review the prepared report, choose your email app, and send it to Support.exeptionHuman@3qinnova.com. Nothing is sent automatically. If available, the report includes the ad response reference, placement, time, and build version. Add what was wrong; a screenshot is optional. You can also use an ad’s own information or AdChoices control.

sections.title: Progress, sound, and offline play
paragraphs: Progress, earned Tokens, cosmetics, and settings are saved on your device. There is no game account or publisher-operated cloud save. Deleting the app can erase progress; we cannot restore a save we do not hold. An operating-system backup may behave differently from a fresh install.

Gameplay works without an internet connection. Ads and privacy-choice checks require a connection. If sound stops, open Audio and use its test/reconnect control, then check device volume. Returning from another app leaves the game paused until you resume.

sections.title: Privacy choices
paragraphs: Open Pause → Settings & help → Ad privacy & info to review the choices available from Google. You can keep playing if ads cannot load or a privacy check fails. Choosing non-personalized ads does not mean that no data is processed.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.intro: This policy covers the EXCEPTION: HUMAN iOS game, its support messages, and this product information page. The operator is 3QInnova LLC. Contact: Support.exeptionHuman@3qinnova.com.

sections.title: Game data on your device
paragraphs: Campaign progress, scores, earned Tokens, cosmetic choices, audio/control settings, and remark history are stored locally. The game does not upload these saves to us. Your device or backup provider may include app data in backups under your settings. There is no game account, chat, user upload service, or publisher-run gameplay analytics service in this version.
The fictional AI’s dialogue is authored game content. The game does not send your play to a generative AI service. We do not request access to your contacts, microphone, photos, or device location.

sections.title: Advertising and Google
paragraphs: The iOS app includes Google AdMob and Google’s User Messaging Platform for banner advertising and privacy choices. They may process IP addresses and approximate location derived from them, app/device identifiers, ad views and interactions, consent choices, and diagnostic/performance information. These data support ad delivery, measurement, fraud prevention, and service operation. Google and advertising providers may process data outside your state or country.

We request non-personalized ads, disable Google’s publisher first-party ID and automatic collection through device location permissions, and do not request Apple’s tracking permission or access to IDFA. Other identifiers and IP-derived information may still be processed. These settings are not a promise of zero data collection. Development builds may show Google test ads, which can still contact Google.

See Google’s Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy and its partner-site/app explanation at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites for its processing, retention, and controls. Advertising partners’ practices can depend on your choices and the ad served.

sections.title: Your ad choices
paragraphs: At launch, the app checks Google’s consent service and presents a privacy message when required. Open Pause → Settings & help → Ad privacy & info to revisit available choices, including applicable US-state opt-out choices. Your choice is not permission to contact you for marketing. If the consent check fails, the app leaves ads off and gameplay available.

We do not sell game saves or support correspondence. Advertising data sharing may qualify as sale, sharing, or targeted advertising under some state laws. Use the ad privacy controls to make the choices offered for your location, or contact us for help. Non-personalized advertising and a state-law opt-out are not necessarily the same setting.

sections.title: Support and ad reports
paragraphs: When you contact us, we receive your email address and whatever you send, such as device details, screenshots, or a description of the problem. An ad report you choose to share can include an ad response reference, time, placement, and app version. No screenshot or report is sent automatically. Our email provider processes messages to deliver and store correspondence.

We use support information to answer requests, investigate problems, handle privacy rights, and protect the service. We do not use it to build advertising audiences. We share it only with service providers helping with those tasks, when you direct us, or when reasonably necessary to comply with law or protect rights and safety. We limit information sent to an advertising provider to what is needed to investigate a report.

sections.title: Website visits
paragraphs: This product information page has no advertising, analytics scripts, or contact form. Its hosting provider, GitHub Pages, may process request information such as IP addresses for operation and security. See https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement. Links to other 3QInnova pages or outside services may have their own notices.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local saves remain until removed by the app/device storage controls or deletion of the app; offloading an iOS app can retain its data. Deleting the app does not delete separate support emails or third-party ad records. Backup copies are subject to your backup provider’s controls.

We retain support correspondence while needed to resolve a request, address related follow-up or disputes, and satisfy legal obligations, and delete or de-identify it when no longer needed. Retention depends on the request and any legal hold. Google and the website/email providers apply their own retention rules; we cannot promise a deletion date for data they independently control.

sections.title: Privacy requests
paragraphs: Depending on where you live and the laws that apply, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or obtain a copy of personal information, opt out of certain advertising uses, and appeal a denied request. Email Support.exeptionHuman@3qinnova.com with the subject Privacy request, or Privacy appeal. An authorized agent may contact us with evidence of authority. We may request proportionate verification and will explain if we cannot locate data or fulfill a request. Do not send government ID unless a suitable verification method has first been agreed.

We will not penalize you for exercising applicable privacy rights. We do not have a central copy of your game save. We can help route requests about Google’s independently controlled records to Google’s privacy controls.

sections.title: Children, security, and changes
paragraphs: The game is intended for teens and adults and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has supplied personal information, contact us so we can investigate and take appropriate action. The App Store’s age rating is separate from this audience statement.

We use reasonable safeguards for information we hold, but no system is completely secure. We may update this policy as the app or its practices change. The updated date will change, and material changes will receive additional notice or consent where required. This policy does not waive rights provided by law.

pages.title: Terms & game information
pages.intro: EXCEPTION: HUMAN is provided by 3QInnova LLC. For support, contact Support.exeptionHuman@3qinnova.com.

sections.title: App Store license
paragraphs: For the iOS app distributed through the Apple App Store, Apple’s Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement applies unless the App Store listing expressly provides a custom agreement. Read it at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/. This page explains the game’s current features; it does not replace that license or limit mandatory consumer rights.

sections.title: Tokens and progress
paragraphs: Tokens and cosmetics are earned through play. They are not money, cannot be redeemed for cash, and have no transfer or resale feature. This version has no in-app purchases or subscription. Progress and settings are saved locally; deleting the app or losing device data may remove them. No publisher-operated cloud recovery is offered.

sections.title: Ads and outside services
paragraphs: The game may show banner ads. Clicking an ad can open a third-party service whose own terms and privacy practices apply. An ad is not our endorsement of its product. Report misleading or inappropriate ads through the support route above. The game does not require an ad click or a purchase to continue playing.

sections.title: Updates and fictional content
paragraphs: The AI antagonist, its claims, and the game’s error messages are fictional entertainment, not technical or professional advice. Future campaigns, features, and release dates are not promised. Updates may change content or features; any future paid offering would have its price and conditions disclosed before purchase.

Use of the game remains subject to the applicable App Store license. Third-party and open-source components retain their own license terms. This page adds no arbitration requirement, class-action waiver, or custom limitation of liability.
